text: TSA estimates 63 aircraft operators currently have regularly scheduled flights and maintain a full Aircraft Operator Standard Security Program (AOSSP).  These aircraft operators generally provide scheduled passenger and public charter service and tend to be larger companies.  TSA estimates approximately five new start-up AOSSP aircraft operators annually.

text: The AOSSP hour burden estimate is comprised of maintaining security programs, CHRC applications, STA applications, maintaining records of compliance, watch list matching, and Incident and Suspicious Activity reporting.  TSA estimates an average annual total hour burden of 558,091 to AOSSP operators and a total annual hour burden cost of $23,915,571 ($71,746,712 over three years).  Table 2 summarizes these calculations.
